label: Nifty futures: official contract data; fixed rules before results
contracts: Choose highest prior-session-volume NIFTY index future with expiry more than 3 calendar days away. Actual historical lot size; full notional collateral, no leverage.

strategies.futures_swing: Prior Nifty close > SMA50 means long; otherwise short. Enter next open, 2 prior ATR initial stop, 20-session time exit, exit when within 3 calendar days of expiry.
strategies.futures_intraday: Same prior-session direction. Enter next open, 1 prior ATR stop, close same session.

costs: 0.05% fee/tax scenario +0.02% slippage per side, doubled stress. Not broker-reconciled tariffs.
limitations: Two years of end-of-day data; no depth/spreads, no margin modelling (full notional collateral). No options-performance inference. Different capital/exposure from other experiments.
